settings.label: Logo override
settings.info: Leave empty to use the official Anjum Mart logo bundled with the theme.

settings.label: Favicon override
settings.info: Leave empty to use the Anjum Mart emblem. Recommended size: 96 x 96 px.

settings.content: Black, gold and white. Black for buttons and the footer, white pages, gold for fine details. The logo is supplied in black/gold (for light areas) and white/gold (for dark areas).

settings.label: Detail accent (lines, icons)
settings.info: Decorative only. Not used for text.

settings.label: Accent text (small labels)
settings.info: Must stay readable on the page background.

settings.label: Show Add to cart button
settings.info: Products with a single variant are added directly. Products with options link to the product page.

settings.label: Show discount percentage on sale badge
settings.info: Calculated from the product's real compare-at price.

settings.content: Shows your logo on top of every product photo in product cards and on the product page, including photos you add later. The original image files in Shopify are not changed.

settings.label: Watermark logo
settings.info: Optional. Leave empty to use the store logo. A transparent PNG works best.

settings.label: White background behind logo
settings.info: Keeps the logo readable on dark or busy photos.

settings.content: A short logo animation when the store is opened, and a logo loader while the next page or search results load.

settings.label: Logo splash screen when the store is opened
settings.info: Shown once per visit (about 1.5 seconds). Not shown to visitors who prefer reduced motion. Turn off if you want shoppers from ads to see the page instantly.

settings.label: Logo loader between pages and for search
settings.info: Appears only when a page takes longer than a moment to load.

settings.content: A small popup in the bottom-left corner. It rotates in-stock products and delivery facts from your catalogue. It never says someone bought something unless that order is listed in the verified feed (Settings, Custom data, Shop, recent_orders). Nothing is generated or invented.

settings.label: Include verified recent orders
settings.info: Only orders you add to the recent_orders list appear. An empty list shows no purchase notice.

settings.label: Show verified orders from the last (days)
Reveal sections on scroll
settings.info: Sections and products fade in as shoppers scroll. Turned off automatically for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Hover effects
settings.info: Lift and zoom effects on product cards, category cards and buttons.

settings.label: Enable order notes
settings.info: Shown on the cart page.

settings.label: Cart information text
settings.info: Optional. Only add delivery or payment details you have confirmed in Shopify settings.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold (Rs.)
settings.info: Leave empty to hide. Must match the free-shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery (it cannot be read automatically). Not needed while delivery is free on every order.

settings.label: Free delivery message
settings.info: Shown in the cart (instead of the progress bar) when delivery is free on every order. Leave empty if you charge for shipping.

settings.label: Show recommendations in the cart drawer
Recommendation type
settings.info: Complementary products are set up in the Shopify Search & Discovery app. When none are set, related products are shown instead.

settings.content: Contact details only appear on the storefront when they are filled in.

settings.label: Show store email
settings.info: Uses the customer-facing email from Settings > General unless an email is entered below.

settings.label: Phone number
settings.info: Shown as entered, e.g. +92 300 1234567

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: International format with country code, e.g. 923001234567. Leave empty to hide all WhatsApp links.

settings.label: WhatsApp pre-filled message
settings.default: Hello Anjum Mart, I have a question.

settings.label: Support hours
settings.info: e.g. Mon–Sat, 10am–8pm

settings.content: Icons only appear for profiles you enter.

settings.label: Facebook
settings.info: https://facebook.com/...

settings.label: Instagram
settings.info: https://instagram.com/...

settings.label: TikTok
settings.info: https://tiktok.com/@...

settings.label: YouTube
settings.info: https://youtube.com/...

settings.label: Pinterest
settings.info: https://pinterest.com/...

settings.label: X (Twitter)
settings.info: https://x.com/...

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: In Search Console choose the HTML tag method and paste only the content value, e.g. abc123XYZ. Not needed if you verify your domain through DNS.

settings.label: Default search description
settings.info: Used when a page has no description of its own. Set the homepage title and description in Online Store > Preferences.
settings.default: Anjum Mart: premium watches and bridal jewellery sets with free delivery all over Pakistan and Cash on Delivery.

settings.label: Default sharing image
settings.info: Used when a page has no image of its own. Leave empty to use the Anjum Mart logo card.
